payload.title: Procedure header declares its kind; validate registry against headers (S)
payload.description:
Only email_submission_processor.tac declares '-- papyrus-procedure-kind: …'. Kinds and filenames disagree elsewhere (newsroom.reporting.context → reporter.tac; newsroom.research.explorer → research_explorer.tac), and nothing checks that a registered kind points at the right procedure.

Fix:
- Every procedure's first line declares its kind.
- At load and in CI, check that each registry entry's file declares the same kind.
- Check that no two files declare the same kind.
- Check that every CLI command in requiredCliProcedures resolves.

Acceptance: a CI check that fails on any mismatch, with unit tests for each failure case.
